Provenance of the bundled reference data

Source: R/tidybrreg-package.R
tidybrreg_provenance.Rd

Every table shipped with tidybrreg is listed here with its source, licence, vintage, the transformations applied, and how the package uses it. The tables are regenerated by data-raw/build_dictionaries.R; the vintages below are the dates of the last regeneration that touched each table, taken from the repository history.

Exported datasets (data/)

field_dict

Package-authored. A mapping from BRREG JSON paths to English column names and R types, written by the package author from the Enhetsregisteret API documentation (https://data.brreg.no/enhetsregisteret/api/dokumentasjon/) and from fields observed on live responses. The Norwegian paths are BRREG's identifiers; the English names and types are the author's editorial choices and carry the package's MIT licence. Last revised 2026-06-16. Used at runtime by every parser.

legal_forms

BRREG code list plus manual translation. code, name_no and expired are retrieved from GET https://data.brreg.no/enhetsregisteret/api/organisasjonsformer, published by the Brønnøysund Register Centre under the Norwegian Licence for Open Government Data (NLOD) 2.0 (https://data.norge.no/nlod/en/2.0); name_en is a manual translation by the package author (unreviewed by BRREG), falling back to name_no for codes without a translation. Retrieved 2026-06-16. Used by brreg_label().

role_types

Package-authored from BRREG documentation. Codes and Norwegian descriptions follow the role codes listed in the Enhetsregisteret roller documentation and the Fullmakt service; English names are a manual translation by the package author. BRREG publishes no machine-readable role code list with translations. Last revised 2026-06-16. Used by brreg_roles(), brreg_roles_legal(), brreg_signatur(), brreg_prokura() and brreg_label().

role_groups

Package-authored from BRREG documentation. As role_types, for role group (rollegruppe) codes. Last revised 2026-06-16. Used by brreg_roles() and brreg_label().

regnskap_dict

Package-authored. As field_dict, for the Regnskapsregisteret filing: dot paths of the filing JSON (OpenAPI 1.1.16, https://data.brreg.no/regnskapsregisteret/regnskap/v3/api-docs, population-verified against the brreg-json-fetcher data-2026-10 release) to English names and R types. Written 2026-10-30. Used by brreg_regnskap().

regnskap_groups

Package-authored. The objects that group line items in the filing, with English and Norwegian names; the level-0 rows are the three statements. The Norwegian names are the presentation-plan captions of the Norwegian Accounting Act; English is a manual translation by the package author. Written 2026-10-30. Used by brreg_regnskap() and brreg_label().

regnskap_items

Package-authored. English and Norwegian labels of the line items named in regnskap_dict, as role_types is for role codes. Written 2026-10-30. Used by brreg_label().

Internal fallback dictionaries (R/sysdata.rda)

nace_codes

Statistics Norway (SSB) KLASS classification 6 (Standard Industrial Classification SN2007), English labels, retrieved from https://data.ssb.no/api/klass/v1/classifications/6/codesAt on 2026-06-16 (the effective date of the codes is that retrieval date). SSB publishes KLASS classifications as open data under NLOD 2.0 according to its data licence page (https://www.ssb.no/en/omssb/tjenester-og-verktoy/api/klass-api); the maintainer has not obtained a separate confirmation, so the statement is reproduced as published. Used only when SSB KLASS is unreachable or source = "bundled" is requested in get_brreg_dic(); the returned tibble carries vintage.

sector_codes

SSB KLASS classification 39 (institutional sector), English labels, same source, licence statement, retrieval date and use as nace_codes.

Register data

Entity, role, group, signature and update data retrieved at runtime come from the Brønnøysund Register Centre's open APIs and are licensed under NLOD 2.0; the licence requires attribution to the Brønnøysund Register Centre when the data are redistributed. KLASS labels retrieved at runtime are Statistics Norway's.
